process_area.title: Lease Portfolio Identification, Recognition & PFRS 16 Transition

fields.Participants: Finance (VS-17.4), Tax (VS-79), Treasury (VS-18), Audit (VS-21), Real Estate (VS-97/VS-20), IT/EA (VS-27/VS-113)
fields.Trigger: PFRS 16 adoption; policy review; audit finding

workflows.name: Lease Accounting Strategy, Policy & PFRS 16/IFRS 16 Framework

Automation Opportunity: - Policy/config library; judgment-documentation templates; auditor-alignment workflow; disclosure templates
Controls: - CTL-674 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Portfolio Identification, Recognition & PFRS 16 Transition (PA-148.1).)
- CTL-674: group PFRS 16 policy; elections documented & auditor-aligned; judgments supported; reviewed annually (W4428)
Cross-references: - links to VS-17 (R2R), VS-79 (tax), VS-18 (treasury), VS-21 (audit), W4427 (system), W4428 (controls), W4425 (disclosures)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Policy-inconsistency risk**: inconsistent elections/judgments across entities → audit finding; mitigated by single group policy & auditor alignment
- **Judgment-abuse risk**: aggressive discount-rate/term estimates distort liabilities; mitigated by documented methodology & auditor challenge
System Touchpoints: - Lease-accounting system (W4427); GL (VS-17); master data/contract (VS-29); tax (VS-79); audit (VS-21); EA (VS-113)
Time Estimate: - ~3–4 weeks annual policy + on PFRS change

steps.activity: Controller/Lease Accounting set the PFRS 16 accounting policy — scope, recognition/exemption elections (short-term, low-value), discount-rate methodology (incremental borrowing rate vs implicit), lease-term (incl. renewal options reasonably certain), and component separation (lease vs non-lease vs service)
Controller/Audit document judgments & estimates (discount rate, term, variable payments, restoration), align with external auditor, and embed in the accounting manual
Lease Accounting/EA/IT translate policy into the lease-accounting system config (W4427), controls (W4428), and disclosure templates (W4425)

fields.Participants: Real Estate (VS-97/VS-20), Procurement (VS-03/VS-34), Treasury (VS-18), IT (VS-99), Fleet (VS-06/VS-61), Legal (VS-100)
fields.Trigger: Initial adoption; new contract; periodic refresh

workflows.name: Lease Portfolio Discovery, Identification & Lease-Component Extraction

Automation Opportunity: - Contract repository scanning for lease indicators; lease-identification decision-tree; auto-registration to repository
Controls: - CTL-674 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Portfolio Identification, Recognition & PFRS 16 Transition (PA-148.1).)
- CTL-674: portfolio sweep covers all lease types; lease-identification test applied; embedded leases extracted; registered in repository (W4426)
Cross-references: - links to VS-97/VS-20 (RE), VS-03/VS-34 (procurement), VS-99 (ITAM), VS-06/VS-61 (fleet), VS-29 (contract), W4409 (policy), W4426 (repository)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Missed-lease risk**: embedded leases in service contracts (e.g. leased copier, leased forklift-with-operator) not identified → under-stated liability; mitigated by portfolio sweep & lease-identification test
- **Component-mis-separation risk**: lease vs service mis-split → wrong recognition; mitigated by documented component-separation policy (W4409)
System Touchpoints: - Lease repository (W4426); contract/master (VS-29); RE (VS-97/VS-20); procurement (VS-03/VS-34); ITAM (VS-99); fleet (VS-06/VS-61); legal (VS-100)
Time Estimate: - ~1–2 days annual sweep; ~1–2 hrs per contract identification

steps.activity: Lease Accounting coordinate a portfolio sweep — real-estate (VS-97/VS-20), equipment/forklifts (VS-138), fleet (VS-06/VS-61), IT/POS hardware (VS-99), fixtures — to identify every contract containing a lease (or embedded lease)
steps.r: Lease Accounting / RE / Procurement / IT / Fleet

steps.activity: Lease Accounting/Legal determine whether each arrangement *contains a lease* (identified asset + right-to-direct-use + obtain-substantially-all-economic-benefits test), separating lease from service/non-lease components
Lease Accounting register identified leases in the lease-accounting repository (W4426), assign unique IDs, owner, entity, and link to the contract record (VS-29)

fields.Participants: Lease Admin (VS-42), Legal (VS-100), Real Estate (VS-97/VS-20), Treasury (VS-18), Tax (VS-79)

workflows.name: Lease Contract Data Capture & Abstracting (Terms, Payments, Options)

Automation Opportunity: - Abstract template with mandatory fields; contract-AI extraction; data-quality validation; legal-review workflow
Controls: - CTL-674 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Portfolio Identification, Recognition & PFRS 16 Transition (PA-148.1).)
- CTL-674: structured abstract with all PFRS 16 data points; legal interpretation of ambiguous clauses; dual review; source-document linked
Cross-references: - links to VS-42 (lease admin), VS-100 (legal), VS-79 (tax), VS-29 (master), W4409 (policy), W4412 (determination), W4426 (repository)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Abstracting-error risk**: wrong term/payment/escalation → wrong liability; mitigated by structured abstract template + dual review
- **Hidden-clause risk**: missed renewal/termination/MAKE-GOOD → wrong term/liability; mitigated by legal interpretation & full-clause capture
System Touchpoints: - Lease repository (W4426); contract/legal (VS-100/VS-42); master data (VS-29); tax (VS-79); treasury (VS-18)

steps.activity: Lease Accounting/Lease Admin abstract each contract — commencement/term/end, renewal/termination options, fixed payments, escalation/index, variable (turnover/usage), incentives/rent-free, initial direct costs, restoration/MAKE-GOOD, PWD/senior discounts, options-to-purchase
Legal/Lease Admin interpret ambiguous clauses (renewal certainty, termination penalty, CPI linkage, sublet consent), and confirm tax treatment (VAT/WHT, documentary stamp) with Tax
Lease Accounting enter the abstract into the lease-accounting repository (W4426) with source-document link, evidence the data-quality check, and route for review

workflows.name: Discount Rate, Lease Term & Payment Determination

Automation Opportunity: - IBR curve per entity/currency/term with market-data feed; renewal-certainty assessment template; payment-build engine
Controls: - CTL-674 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Portfolio Identification, Recognition & PFRS 16 Transition (PA-148.1).)
- CTL-674: IBR methodology documented & refreshed; lease-term assessed with evidence; payment-build per PFRS 16; reviewed by Treasury/Audit
Cross-references: - links to VS-18 (treasury), VS-21 (audit), W4409 (policy), W4411 (abstract), W4414 (recognition), W4418 (remeasurement)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Discount-rate-error risk**: wrong IBR → materially wrong liability (large PV effect over long retail leases); mitigated by documented IBR methodology & periodic refresh
- **Term-assessment-error risk**: wrong renewal-certainty → wrong term/liability; mitigated by documented assessment & evidence
System Touchpoints: - Lease-accounting system (W4427); treasury (VS-18); audit (VS-21); market-rate data feed; BI (VS-28)
Time Estimate: - ~1–2 hrs per lease determination; IBR refresh periodic

steps.activity: Treasury/Lease Accounting determine the discount rate — lessee's incremental borrowing rate (IBR) by currency/term/entity (or implicit rate if readily determinable), using a documented methodology & market data

Lease Accounting determine the lease term — non-cancellable period + periods covered by options reasonably certain to be exercised (renewal) / not to be exercised (termination), with documented assessment

Lease Accounting determine lease payments — fixed + escalation + variable-based-on-index/rate + exercise-purchase-option-if-reasonably-certain + penalties-for-termination + MAKE-GOOD, excluding variable-based-on-performance/usage

Automation Opportunity: - Classification rules-engine vs policy; exemption-evidence capture; sublease/SLB/intercompany auto-flag
Controls: - CTL-674 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Portfolio Identification, Recognition & PFRS 16 Transition (PA-148.1).)
- CTL-674: exemptions applied per class-of-asset policy; election & basis documented; sublease/SLB/intercompany flagged; reviewed (W4428)
Cross-references: - links to VS-21 (audit), VS-29 (master), W4409 (policy), W4414 (recognition), W4421 (sublease), W4422 (exemptions), W4424 (intercompany)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Mis-classification risk**: lease wrongly exempted → under-stated liability (audit finding); mitigated by exemption-class policy & documentation
- **Inconsistent-election risk**: per-asset vs per-class inconsistency; mitigated by class-of-asset election policy
System Touchpoints: - Lease-accounting system (W4427); policy (W4409); audit (VS-21); master data (VS-29)

steps.activity: Lease Accounting apply recognition exemptions per policy (W4409) — short-term (≤12 months, no purchase option) and low-value (e.g. <USD 5,000) — electing by class of underlying asset
Lease Accounting classify low-value/short-term as expense-on-straight-line (no ROU/liability) vs all other leases as on-balance-sheet; document the election and basis
Lease Accounting flag subleases (W4421), sale-and-leaseback (W4421), and intercompany (W4424) for special classification

workflows.name: Initial Recognition — ROU Asset & Lease Liability Calculation

Automation Opportunity: - PV auto-calculation; ROU-build engine; controlled journal posting to GL; FA-register auto-link
Controls: - CTL-674 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Portfolio Identification, Recognition & PFRS 16 Transition (PA-148.1).)
- CTL-674: PV system-calculated; ROU-build per PFRS 16; controlled posting; reconciled to GL/FA register (W4425); reviewed
Cross-references: - links to VS-17 (GL), VS-35 (FA), VS-21 (audit), W4412 (rate/term/payment), W4417 (subsequent), W4425 (close), W4428 (controls)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Calculation-error risk**: wrong PV/ROU build → mis-stated asset/liability; mitigated by system-calculated PV + dual review
- **Posting-error risk**: wrong GL/asset classification; mitigated by controlled posting & reconciliation (W4425)
System Touchpoints: - Lease-accounting system (W4427); GL (VS-17); fixed-asset register (VS-35); audit (VS-21); BI (VS-28)

steps.activity: Lease Accounting calculate the **lease liability** at present value of unpaid lease payments (discounted per W4412) over the lease term (W4412)

Lease Accounting calculate the **ROU asset** = liability + initial direct costs + estimated restoration/MAKE-GOOD − lease incentives received + prepayments, and post the journal (DR ROU asset / CR liability)
Lease Accounting post the commencement journal to GL (VS-17), assign asset/sub-asset to the fixed-asset register (links VS-35), and evidence review

fields.Participants: Controller, Finance (VS-17.4), Audit (VS-21), Treasury (VS-18), IT (VS-27), External Auditor
fields.Trigger: Initial PFRS 16 adoption; new entity acquisition (VS-130)
fields.Volume: One-time per entity/adoption; re-applied on M&A (VS-130)

Automation Opportunity: - Transition-method engine; opening-balance calculator with practical expedients; comparative-restatement tool; disclosure auto-gen
Controls: - CTL-674 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Portfolio Identification, Recognition & PFRS 16 Transition (PA-148.1).)
- CTL-674: transition method documented & auditor-approved; opening balances calculated; comparatives restated if required; disclosed (W4425)
Cross-references: - links to VS-17 (GL), VS-21 (audit), VS-130 (M&A), W4409 (policy), W4425 (disclosure), W4427 (system)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Transition-error risk**: wrong method/calculation → restatement; mitigated by method documentation & auditor sign-off
- **Comparative-restatement risk**: full-retrospective complexity; mitigated by system-restatement & dual review
System Touchpoints: - Lease-accounting system (W4427); GL (VS-17); audit (VS-21); BI (VS-28); transition module

steps.activity: Controller/Lease Accounting select & document the transition method — modified retrospective (cumulative adjustment to opening retained earnings, no restatement) vs full retrospective — per policy (W4409) and auditor guidance

Lease Accounting calculate opening ROU asset & lease liability per the chosen method (e.g. modified-retrospective: ROU = liability, or liability less future-rent, with practical expedients), and post transition adjustment
Lease Accounting restate comparatives if full-retrospective, update disclosures (W4425), and reconcile to auditor sign-off

fields.Participants: Controller, Consolidation (VS-17), Intercompany (VS-72), Treasury (VS-18), IT/EA (VS-27/VS-113), Tax (VS-79)
fields.Volume: 5-entity group (Holdings, Depot, Logistics, Digital Commerce, Property Mgmt)

workflows.name: Multi-Entity (5 Entities) Consolidated Lease Accounting Setup

Automation Opportunity: - Multi-entity config templates; intercompany-lease auto-match & eliminate; consolidated ROU/liability dashboard
Controls: - CTL-674 (ensure controlled execution — Lease Portfolio Identification, Recognition & PFRS 16 Transition (PA-148.1).)
- CTL-674: per-entity config per group standard; intercompany-lease map maintained; eliminations validated (W4424); reconciled to group FS
Cross-references: - links to VS-17 (consolidation/GL), VS-72 (intercompany), VS-97 (lessor/RE), VS-27 (IT), W4424 (elimination), W4425 (close), W4427 (system)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Intercompany-leakage risk**: intercompany lease not eliminated → double-count in consolidation; mitigated by intercompany-lease map & elimination rules (W4424)
- **Entity-config-inconsistency risk**: different IBR/COA across entities → consolidation friction; mitigated by group config standard
System Touchpoints: - Lease-accounting system multi-entity (W4427); consolidation (VS-17); intercompany (VS-72); GL (VS-17); RE/lessor (VS-97); IT (VS-27)

steps.activity: Lease Accounting/Consolidation configure per-entity lease accounting (entity-specific IBR, COA, currency PHP, fiscal cal) and the intercompany-lease map (e.g. Property Mgmt as lessor to Depot, links VS-97/VS-72)
Lease Accounting/Intercompany identify intercompany leases (lessor & lessee within group), and set up the consolidation-elimination rules (W4424)
Consolidation/Lease Accounting validate the consolidated ROU/liability, run eliminations (W4424), and reconcile to the group FS (VS-17)
